# Read in
### recur/control
```{r}
dfCC<-read_csv('.../case_control.csv')
```

### Whole cohort
```{r}
dfWC<-read_csv('.../whole_cohort.csv')
```

# Format
```{r}
### Prep dfs
### add outcome labels
unfav<-c('AU178L','AU208J','BA112U','BA118J','BA170X','KM519H','KM547Q',
         'UC115R','UC205E','UC160K','UC109B') #'BA118J'~ 'Treatment failure',
recur<-c('AU178L','BA112U','BA170X','KM519H','KM547Q','UC115R','UC160K','UC205E')
control<-c('AU213R','BA151Y','BA120W','KM523J','KM524Q','UC174A','UC113C','UC116X') 


dfWC<-dfWC%>%
  mutate(label=case_when(scrno%in%recur~'recurrence',
                         scrno%in%control~'control',
                         TRUE~'whole_cohort'),
         outcome_binary=case_when(scrno%in%recur~'recurrence',
                                  TRUE~'not_recurrence'),
         visit_c = scale(visit_num, scale=T),
         age_c = scale(age, scale=T))%>%
  filter(scrno!='BA118J')%>%
  rename(creatinine = `Creatinine_umol/L`,
         MCHC = `MCHC_g/dL`,
         neutrophils_pct = `Neutrophils_%`,
         neutrophils_abs = `neutrophils_abs_merged_x10E9/l`)%>%
  group_by(scrno) %>%
  fill(age, .direction = "downup") %>%
  fill(sex, .direction = "downup") %>%
  fill(age_c, .direction = "downup") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

dfCC<-dfCC%>%
  mutate(label=case_when(scrno%in%recur~'recurrence',
                         scrno%in%control~'control',
                         TRUE~'whole_cohort'),
         outcome_binary=case_when(scrno%in%recur~'recurrence',
                                  TRUE~'not_recurrence'),
         visit_c = scale(visit_num, scale=T),
         age_c = scale(age, scale=T)) %>%
  filter(scrno!='BA118J')%>%
  rename(creatinine = `Creatinine_umol/L`,
         MCHC = `MCHC_g/dL`,
         neutrophils_pct = `Neutrophils_%`,
         neutrophils_abs = `neutrophils_abs_merged_x10E9/l`)%>%
  group_by(scrno) %>%
  fill(age, .direction = "downup") %>%
  fill(sex, .direction = "downup") %>%
  fill(age_c, .direction = "downup") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

```


# Models
## Loop
### Case-control
```{r}
covs<- c("vs_sys","vs_dia","vs_hr","bmi" ,"creatinine","MCHC",
          "neutrophils_pct", "neutrophils_abs", "MCV_fL","ML_ratio",  
           "ttp_log","ML_ratio","NL_ratio","NM_ratio","EN_ratio",
         "EB_ratio","GL_ratio","LP_ratio")

pvals<- numeric(length(covs))
names(pvals)<-covs

for (var in covs) {

  data<-dfCC[!is.na(dfCC[[var]]) & !is.infinite(dfCC[[var]]),]
  
  null_model<-reformulate(c("visit_num + outcome_binary + sex + age_c + (1|scrno)"),
                          var)
  alt_model<-reformulate(c("visit_num:outcome_binary + visit_num + sex + age_c + 
                           outcome_binary + (1|scrno)"), var)
  
  model_0<-lmer(null_model, data=data, REML=FALSE)
  model_1<-lmer(alt_model, data=data, REML=FALSE)
  
  if (isSingular(model_0)) warning("Singular fit in model_0 for:", var)
  if (isSingular(model_1)) warning("Singular fit in model_1 for:", var)
  
  comparison<-anova(model_0, model_1)
  pvals[var]<-comparison$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
}
```

### Whole cohort
```{r}
pvals2<- numeric(length(covs))
names(pvals2)<-covs

for (var in covs) {

  data<-dfWC[!is.na(dfWC[[var]]) & !is.infinite(dfWC[[var]]),]
  
  null_model<-reformulate(c("visit_num + outcome_binary + sex + age_c + (1|scrno)"),
                          var)
  alt_model<-reformulate(c("visit_num:outcome_binary + visit_num + sex + age_c + 
                           outcome_binary + (1|scrno)"), var)
  
  model_0<-lmer(null_model, data=data, REML=FALSE)
  model_1<-lmer(alt_model, data=data, REML=FALSE)
  
  if (isSingular(model_0)) warning("Singular fit in model_0 for:", var)
  if (isSingular(model_1)) warning("Singular fit in model_1 for:", var)
  
  comparison<-anova(model_0, model_1)
  pvals2[var] <-comparison$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
}

```

### MTC correction (BH correction)
```{r}
pvals_adj<-p.adjust(pvalTot, method="BH")

results<-data.frame(
  covariate=names(pvalTot), 
  pval=pvalTot,
  padj=pvals_adj
)
results<-results[order(results$padj, decreasing=FALSE),]
results
```


## Check models for effect size
##### BMI 
```{r}
bmi_alt <- lmer(bmi ~ visit_num*label + (1|scrno), data = dfCC, REML = FALSE)#sex+age_c+
bmi_altWC <- lmer(bmi ~ visit_num*outcome_binary + (1|scrno), data = dfWC, REML = FALSE)#sex+age_c+
#summary(bmi_altWC)
```

##### HR
```{r}
hr_alt <- lmer(vs_hr ~ visit_num*label + (1|scrno), data = dfCC, REML = FALSE)#sex+age_c+
hr_altWC <- lmer(vs_hr ~ visit_num*outcome_binary + (1|scrno), data = dfWC, REML = FALSE)#sex+age_c+
#summary(hr_altWC)
```

##### ML ratio
```{r}
MLR_alt<-lmer(ML_ratio~visit_num*label + (1|scrno), data=dfCC, REML=FALSE) #sex+age_c+
MLR_altWC<-lmer(ML_ratio~visit_num*outcome_binary + (1|scrno), data=dfWC, REML=FALSE)#sex+age_c+
#summary(MLR_altWC)
```


##### LP ratio (WC only)
```{r}
LPR_altWC<-lmer(LP_ratio~visit_num*outcome_binary + (1|scrno), data=dfWC, REML=FALSE)#sex+age_c+
#summary(LPR_altWC)
```


#### MTC for individual p-values from models
```{r}
models<-list('bmi_alt','bmi_altWC','hr_alt','hr_altWC','MLR_alt','MLR_altWC','LPR_altWC')
mod_pvals<-models |> ## observe the quotes
  map_dfr( ~ list(
            model = .x,
            coeff = lmerTest:::get_coefmat(get(.x)) |>
              as.data.frame() |>
              rownames_to_column())) |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  unnest_wider(coeff)

mod_pvals<-mod_pvals|>
  group_by(model) |>
  slice(n())

mod_pvals$p_adj<-p.adjust(mod_pvals$`Pr(>|t|)`, method="BH")
mod_pvals
```

## VarCompTest
```{r}
## for all vars of interest
model_intercept <- lmer(`var` ~ visit_num*label + (1|scrno),
                          data = merged, REML=F)
model_slope <- lmer(`var` ~ visit_num*label + (visit_num|scrno),
                      data = merged, REML=F)

varCompTest(model_slope,model_intercept,pval.comp="approx")
```
